༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsalazhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsalazhes bya ba bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsal zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /me long ye shes gzugs snang lha yi sku/ /legs bzhengs mi 'khrugs mgon la gus btud nas/ /gang 'dir cho ga'i zur 'debs bshad kyis nyon/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga la ras bris dang rdul tshon la brten pa gnyis las/ dang po shes sla ba dang*/ nyin gcig la cho ga rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas te/ de'i tshul kho bos nyung ngu rnam gsal du bkod zin la/ gzhung de la bltos pa'i dbang du byas nas/ 'dir rdul tshon gyi phyogs brjod na don gnyis te/ sngon du bsnyen pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor las kyi rim pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ rnal 'byor dang bcas pa'i bzlas brjod dang*/ dus rgyun gyi bzlas brjod do/ /dang po ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ gnas dben par/ sangs rgyas kyi rten gyi spyan sngar ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum bshams la/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa nas mchod bstod kyi bar sngon du btang nas/ rang gi snying ga na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dbus kyi gtso bo mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags kyi ye ge sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer slar 'dus te rang la thim pas bdag nyid kyi tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par bsams la/ sems ma yengs par bzlas brjod ci nus bya/ thun gtong ba'i tshe slar yang mchod bstod bsngo ba smon lam bya ste/

thun mtshams su bskor ba dang*/ tshwa tshwa la sogs dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya zhing*/ srod thun gyi mthar gtor ma cha gsum btang la/ phyogs skyong rnams bsnyen pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams su zhal phyir bstan nas bzhugs te bar chad bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa bsgom/ gtor ma gnyis pa'i skabs su/ lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs rnams sgrub pa po la dges shing bar chad bsrung ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas rang gnas su bzhud par bsam zhing*/ gtor ma gsum pa'i skabs su/ 'byung po gdug pa can rnams dpag tshad dam rgyang grags kyi bar du bskrad par bsam la/ mtshams gcod kyi sngags lan gsum bzlas/ rang nyid 'khod pa'i gnas khang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re phyi rol du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ / de ltar bsnyen bsgrub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du dkar gsum la brten pa'i gdan gcig gam gdan gnyis bya/ phyi dro'i kha zas/ sha chang sgog btsong la phug /rang gi kham 'phro rnams spangs/ snod mkhar ba dang lo ma dang lag mthil rnams su mi za/ de ltar gtsang sbra dang ldan pas 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa'i tshul du bzlas te/ mthar grub na bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bya/ ma grub na tsha tsha mang du btab/ thun gsum gyi rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas nyams su blang ba ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa dus rgyun gyi bzlas brjod ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs brgyud bskul bas bsnyen pa'i rgyun de nyid mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir nyin re bzhin skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor mthar bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar du 'chag med kyi tshul gyis nyams su blangs pas/ las gcig las gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ba dang*/

mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa ma lus par zad par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa mdo las bshad do/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa la/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bri ba'i gnas su cha gsum ltar gtor ma gsum bsham/ mchod pa lnga dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ gu gul la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bshams la/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas sngon du song nas/ gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong la phul ba'i mthar/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag la stsal zhing dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mthar phyin pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de/ phyogs skyong las bslang ba'o/ /de nas gtor ma gnyis pa 'byung po spyi la phul la 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sa phyogs 'dir bdag la gnang zhing zhes sogs brjod pas bslang ste/ 'di gnyis ni zhi bas sa bslang ba'o/ /de nas bgegs gtor bsngos la gdon khyod rang gi gnas su song*/ zhes pa'i 'jug tu/ sa'i phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa'i 'byung po gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren gyi rigs gang yod pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig / ces brjod la gtor ma sgo drung du dor ro/ khro bo'i sngags brjod cing rol mo drag du bya/ sa phyogs gu gul gyi bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs la bgegs rnams byer bar bsams pa ni drag pos bslang ba ste/ sa bslang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas phyogs skyong dang 'byung po rnams gshegs su gsol/ rang mi 'khrugs pa'i nga rgyal gyis kāṃ ka ni bzla bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su lag pa gnyis ka bzhag la/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes nyer gcig brjod pas/

sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzlas pas/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams te/ sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs ba'o/ / de nas kāṃ ka ni/ bzla bzhin du de tsam byed pa'i sa gzhi mchod pa'i gzhi dang bcas pa dri bzang kyis chus byug /ga dar legs par bya ba ni las dang bya bas sbyang ba ste sa sbyang ba'i cho ga'o/ / de nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu'i 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gy-i dbus su 'dug la/ hūṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya/ a haṃ/ zhes pas mi 'khrugs pa'i nga rgyal gzung la/ bdag gis sa'i phyogs 'dir/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po m-i 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor bris pa sems can gyi don rgya chen po bya'o/ /zhes sems bskyed pa ni blos bzung ba'o/ /de nas rjes chog tu bshad pa ltar byas la/ bkra shis brjod de nub dang po'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa sta gon la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ sa chog byas pa'i gnas su thig chen brgyad tsam mam/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar las thig rdzogs par btab la/ lha'i gnas su dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu tshang bar bkod/ sa lha'i tshom bu yang bkod la bzhag /mtha' skor du mchod pa dang gtor ma dang*/ bum pa dang*/ 'og tu slob ma sta gon la dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang tshang bar bshams/ de nas dpon slob rnams stan la 'khod de mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ sa lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ lha sta gon/ slob ma sta gon no/ /dang po ni sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsal btab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas gdan la bzhugs par dmigs la/ sngar gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/

g.yon rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar mdog dkar po'i na bzas stod g.yogs shing*/ dar kha dog sna tshogs pa'i shams thabs kyis mdzes par klubs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas sku la spras pa zhal gyi pad+mo rab tu bzhad cing*/ pad zla'i gdan la phyed krung gis bzhugs pa klu dang sa bdag tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ oṃ pri thi wi de bī sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes brjod la pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya bca' zhing rol mo'i bar du bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pri thi wī dā+e bī sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo/ zhes sogs lan gsum dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas gtor ma phul te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyobs pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ lan gsum gyi mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par bya ba'i ched du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma la yang dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/ sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal nas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig

/ ces gnang ba sbyin pa bsam/ de nas mchod yon phul la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas/ sa'i lha mos de nyid la thim par mos la sa lha'i mchod gtor rnams phyir bsal te/ sa sta gon no/ /gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni cho ga'i bum bskyed kyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bsgrub pa nyid yin no/ /gsum pa lha sta gon ni/ bsangs sbyangs bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/ tshom bu'i steng du cho ga gsum gyi lha dgu bskyed la/ bdag gtso bo dang tha mi dad du bya/ gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas mnyes par byas nas rang la bstim pa sogs ras bris kyi cho ga ltar bya zhing*/ mchod bstod rgyas par bya ba mdun bskyed ltar bsgrubs nas/ dkyil 'khor la lta zhing pus mo g.yas pa btsugs/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ nang par spyan drangs pa'i phyir snyan gsan dbab ste/ mi 'khrugs mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ / rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ / bcom ldan bdag ni gus par lags/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad pa rigs/ / sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang*/ /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*/ /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*/ /gang yang lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya yis/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming*/ /ngan song sbyong ba ci nus kyis/ /cho ga bzhin du bri lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas rnams la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyi rlabs par mdzad du gsol/

/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma nas/ stsal du gsol/ gyi bar sngar bzhin bya/ gtor ma cha gsum cho ga bzhin rjes su sgrubs te lha sta gon no/ /bzhi pa slob ma sta gon la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma khrus byas/ dang po phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas/ gral la 'khod la/ gnyis pa thog mar myang 'das kyi bsams pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug pa'i phyir/ rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen blo can rnams la ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsungs pa yi/ /yang dag cho ga rjes su gnang*/ kha cig gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer/ /dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan gyi bsod nams 'dod/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gzhol/ /blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer 'jug /'jig rten 'di 'bras dor nas ni/ /'jig rten pha rol mgron gnyer na/ /gang phyir tshe 'di bde blag 'grub/ /'di yis 'jig rten pha rol min/ /de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /don du yid ni brtan par gyis/ zhes pas don bshad la/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed du gzhug go /gsum pa rna ba gtad par bskul ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa brtan po'i yid kyis nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs dang*/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ / ces gdams/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab bo/ /lnga pa spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bu tshur shog shig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ / khyod ni tshul chen snod yin no/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/

/ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pas/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzang chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig ces brjod la spro ba bskyed/ drug pa rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs gsal btab la/ bdag bskyed ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum bya'o/ /bdun pa dag pa lha'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis mi 'khrugs par bskyed nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te gnas gsum du gtugs la/ kāṃ kā ni/ lan re brjod pas/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum kun rtog ma lus pa bcom nas/ dag pa de gzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa bya'o/ / brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de ltar lhar gsal ba la dga' ston gyi tshul gyi mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod/ dgu pa so shing sbyin pa ni/ so shing me tog gi rtse mo can rnams dri bzang gi chus byug cing*/

a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ kāṃ ka ni tshar gcig gis byin gyis rlabs te/ slob ma la byin la/ kha shar ram byang du bltas te tshom bu'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes brjod cing 'dor du gzhug de'i rtse mor shar lho/ nub byang*/ steng 'og rnams su bltas na zhi rgyas dbang drag mkha' spyod sa 'og rnams 'grub cing mtshams rnams su bltas na bum pa bzang po la sogs pa dngos grub phran tshegs rnams 'grub la/ dkyil 'khor du ma lhung na dngos grub med par go bar bya'o/ /bcu pa kha dag par bya ba'i phyir khyod chu sbyin pa ni/ kāṃ ka ni/ bzlas te byin gyis brlabs pa'i dri bzang gi chu khyor bar lan gsum blud cing*/ oṃ hrī bi shud+dha sarba dharma/ sarba bi kalpa a pa na ya hū ཾ / bcu gcig pa bsrung skud ni/ skud pa dmar po lus tshad dang mnyam par gsum sbril du byas pa la/ rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i skud pa dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam par/ rdo rje mdud pa gsum gyis bsdams pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad bsrungs ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu dpag tu med par byon/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob ma'i dpung pa g.yon par kāṃ ka ni brjod cing bcings la bum chus byug cing*/ oṃ bud+dha mā ti rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swāhā/ dha ra ka s+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ bcu gnyis pa ku sha byin pa ni/ dhi dang ha las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs zhing gsal po 'byung ba'i nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs la/ kāṃ ka na ི'i mthar dhi zhes brjod cing chung ba lag pa g.yas pa dang*/

ha/ zhes brjod cing che ba g.yon du sbyin no/ / bcu gsum pa zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni / 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /res 'ga' 'byung zhing mi 'byung srid/ /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung*/ /gang zhig sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med don/ /de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon chad sdig pa ci mchis pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis/ /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na/ /grags pa mtha' yas gsang sngags kyi/ /spyod tshul gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// gong 'phang bla na med pa 'gyur/ /spyod mchog 'di la gang rnams kyis/ /blo gros shin tu dri med pa/ /de rnams kyis ni sdug bsngal kun/ /'byung ba'i ngan 'gro yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /de ring rnyed pa mnyam med rnyed/ /gang gis khyed rnams rgyal ba kun/ /bdag nyid chen po sras bcas kyi/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kyis/ /yongs su bzung ste skye 'gyur ba/ /de yis khyed rnams theg chen las/ /legs par skye ba nyid du 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /gang la khyed rnams 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ zhes brjod cing don bshad/ bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag pa ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur gyis nyol cig dang*/ /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la drang por smos/ / zhes brjod cing sngar byin pa'i shu ka che ba gdan dang*/ chung ba sngas kyi tshul du gyis la nyol cig byas la/ dran pa gsum gyis gdams pa bya ste/ mi ma yin gyi bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i don du rang lus mi 'khrugs par dran pa dang*/ gnyid kyi mun pas bying ba dang myos par mi 'gyur ba'i don du snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa dang*/

ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po da ltar shes par 'gyur ba'i don du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems lha'i sa bon hūṃ du dran par byas nas nyol cig /rmi lam gang mthong ba snga dro nga la smros shig /ces brjod/ rmi lam ngan na bsrung ba dang*/ bzang na spro ba skyed/ de nas rjes chog tu bshad pa ltar mchod bstod bya/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dngos grub blangs la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod nas/ se gol gtogs la/ lha rnams sang 'byon par bzhed bzhin pa'i sgo nas gshegs par bsam/ bkra shis kyi mtha' brten pa/ nub gnyis pa sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i bya ba gnyis/ dang po la dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i cho ga gnyis/ dang po ni thig gi bri ba la/ shar nub ma nor tshangs thig gdab/ /de yi phyed btsal mtshan ma bya/ /de steng shar nub mtho de'i bar/ /slar yang rtags bya de steng gzung*/ /mtho de'i tshad kyi thig skud kyis/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su bya rjes btsal/ /de steng tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ /shar nub lta bur mtshan ma bya/ /de dang dbus bar srad bu ni/ /phyogs bzhi mtshan ma'i steng gzung nas/ /zur bzhir bya rjes btsal bar bya/ /de steng zur thig gnyis btab nas/ /dkyil 'khor che chung gang byed kyi/ /mda' thig gru bzhir gdab par bya/ /zur bzhi gsum gtubs rim pa gsum/ /phyi ma phyed du bgo bar bya/ /cha chen gnyis ni 'byung ba 'gyur/ /nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /phyi ma phyed gdab de'i phyi'ang phyed/ /rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu dang*/ /dra phyed shar bu mda' yab 'byung*/ /dbus su brgyad cha phyis bgo'o/ /sgo de'i bzhi cha cha chung yin/

/phyis pa'i rtsa thig rtse mo nas/ /gyen du cha chung bzhi btab la/ /'phred du gnyis dang steng du gnyis/ /sgo khyud sgo 'gram sgo logs 'grub/ /de phyir cha chung re re'i sar/ /'dod yon snam bu'i phyi thig nas/ /mda' yab rtse reg thigs gsum btab/ / mun snam ka ba ka rgyan yin/ /de bzhin g.yon la'ang shes par bya/ /de steng rta babs sgo tshad gnyis/ /sgo tshad dang po cha bzhir bgo /rta babs snam bu bzhi ma 'byung*/ /phyi ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs kyi sa/ /rta babs snam bu'i phyir mtha' ni/ /dang po ka rgyan mtha' dang mnyam/ /de nas cha phran re res thung*/ /pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs sogs ni/ /dkyil 'khor spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ /gu ṇa ha ri'i bskor tshul ni/ /snam bu gnyis pa'i phyi thig dang*/ /tshangs thig 'dzom pa nas bzung ste/ /cha phran gnyis kyi dbus ma bskor/ /snam bu dang po'i phyi thig dang*/ tshangs thig 'dzom pa'i g.yas g.yon tu/ /cha phran gnyis re phyin pa nas/ /cha phran gcig gis g.yas g.yon bskor/ /de rnams nang du phyed re bskor/ /g.yas g.yon rwa yis bskor tshul ni/ / tshangs phyir gsum dang mda' phyir gcig /phyin te ka rgyan rtse nas bskor/ /de nas 'phred gnyis gyen du gcig /phyin te snga ma'i tshad kyis bskor/ /de yi phyi ru cha phran gnyis/ /pad+ma'i khor yug bskor bar bya/ rdau ra cha phran gnyis pa dang*/ me'i sa cha chen gcig gis bskor/ /rtsa thig nang gi bya tshul ni/ /dbus nas zlum por bskor byas la/ /de'i nang ma cha gsum bgo /nang gi gsum cha lta bar bskor/ /de yi phyi nas cha phran phyed/ /bskor ba de ni mu khyud do/ /phyi ma gnyis po pad+ma ste/ / gcus nas thig gdab 'dab brgyad bri/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /de ltar las kyi thig gis cha dbye ba'i rjes thogs su/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su ras la sogs pa'i gzhi'i steng du/ rdul tshon sngon po la hūṃ/ dkar po la oṃ/

ser po la triṃ/ dmar po la hrīḥ ljang khu la a bris la phyogs ma nor bar bkod/ ras kyi thig skud kha dog lnga pa ring ba dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur sbom phra sgo'i nyi shu cha'i tshad dang ldan pa rnams rdul tshon so so'i steng du kha dog dang mthun pa chun por gcus la bzhag pa'i mdun du nyer spyod lnga bshams la/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas bgegs bsangs/ swabhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbus dang phyogs kyi thig skud rdul tshon rnams pad zla'i steng du hūṃ oṃ traṃ hrīḥ.a rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnod dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ shar du rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ lhor rin 'byung ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ byang du don grub ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ / de nas mchod pa byin gyis rlabs la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod la dril bu dkrol zhing*/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ rang gi mig gnyis dza las nyi ma dang zla bar bsam la/ dip+ta diṣ+ti aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes pa'ang mig la bkod de/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon rigs lnga'i rang bzhin spyan drangs la bstim

nas oṃ badz+ra tsi dra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes nyer gcig brjod pas byin gyis rlabs te/ slar yang mchod bstod/ zhu ba las byung pa'i rigs lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin gyi rdul tshon dang ye shes kyi srad bur gyur bar bsam zhing*/ kāṃ ka ni lan gsum bzla/ de nas slob ma dang lhan cig tu/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga te/ sarba dharma s+pha ra s+pha ra/ a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharma a d+yan ta a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharma/ zhes brjod cing thig skud rnams dang po so sor bsgril/ de nas gcig tu bsgril la yang kāṃ ka ni/ bzla zhing dri bzang gis phyug /rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgyas bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su traṃ ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brgyad kyis byin gyis rlabs so/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu dang thig skud bzung la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi bden bral dang*/ grogs dbang ldan du gnas pas/ hūṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya a haṃ/ zhes pas slob dpon rang nyid mi 'khrugs pa'i nga rgyal gzung*/ maṅga la de bi zhes pas grogs bkra shis kyi lha mor mos la/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod cing thig sna gtad/ des kyang dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod cing blang*/ gnyis char gyi g.yon pa'i khu tshur dril bu dang bcas pas thig skud lte ba'i thad kar bzung la/ phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bsams te/ slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du song la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su traṃ ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ slob dpon g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas thig skud kyi dbus nas gcus te sgra dang ldan par gdab cing*/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi ngag nas brjod pa bzhin nam mkha' las kyang sgra byung bar bsams la/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul ma 'debs/ / zhes brjod la/ nam mkha' dang sa gzhi la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du slob dpon lho dang slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/

slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon rlung dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas nub/ slob dpon rlung mtshams de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang*/ slob dpon me dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas lho/ slob dpon me mtshams nyid du bzhugs nas/ slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dang*/ slob dpon bden bral dang slob ma dbang ldan du phyin la zur thig gnyis pa gdab ste/ dkyil 'khor spyi las 'byung ba ltar/ slob dpon dbang ldan du mi 'gro zhing slob ma me mtshams mi 'gro ba'i sgo nas ye thig 'khrul mang du btab la/ de nas slob dpon nub sgor phyin nas rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ oṃ badz+ra bai ga kra ma hūṃ zhes brjod pa'i ye thig nam mkhar bteg la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khod de rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ mig gnyis hri las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ las khro bo'i rdo rjer mos la/ kro dha tiṣ+ṭha hrīḥ zhes brjod la sgo bzhir bltas pas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad bsal bar bsams la/ sgo phyi nang gi rtsa thig dbye'o/ / ye shes kyi thig gis byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ / de nas slob dpon dbus su/ 'dug nas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis tshon blangs la/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing rtsig pa rim pa lnga phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i pañtsa re kha lnga ldan du dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor gyis sgo tshang gcig gi bar du bri/ de la mchod nas rin po che'i snod bkab la steng du rdo rje bzhag la bsrung*/ phyis sbrel ran pa dang snod bsal la/ ngan na phyir bzlog bya/ bzang na spro ba bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma sogs kyis bris ste/ nang gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ /dbang ldan sngo la bden bral ljang*/

zhes sogs kyi lugs ltar bris la/ dbus su lha mtshan rdo rje sngon po/ shar du dpal be'u dkar po/ lhor pad+ma dmar po/ nub tu gdugs sngon po/ byang du dung ljang gu/ shar lhor 'khor lo dkar po/ lho nub tu rgyal mtshan sngo skya/ nub byang du bum pa dmar skya/ byang shar du gser nya ljang gu ste lha so so'i kha dog mtshon par bya ba'i phyi'i mu khyud rdo rje'i gdung zlum sngon po la rdo rje ser pos mtshan pa bri/ dkyil 'khor phyogs mdog /'dod yon dmar po pha gu ser/ dra phyed gzhi sngon po la phreng ba ci mdzes/ mda' yab dang pu shu khra bo/ rta babs kyi ka ba phyogs mdog /ka rgyan mdzes tshon rta babs kyi snam bu dang po dmar po/ gnyis pa sngon po/ gsum pa ljang khu/ bzhi pa ser po/ glang po'i rgyab kyi nang sngon po la dra phyed sna tshogs/ pad+ma dkar dmar/ chos 'khor ser po/ gdugs sna tshogs/ rdo rje'i rwa rnams phyogs mdog /khyams ljang khu/ khor yug gi pad+ma kha dog sna tshogs/ rdo rje'i gzhi sngon po la rdo rje ser po de'i phyi rol me ri kha dog sna tshogs pa bri ste/ de ltar bri ba rnams tshar pa dang*/ thig tshon gyi lha la mchod bstod byas nas gshegs su gsol ba ni tshon gyis bṛ ba ste dkyil 'khor bṛ ba'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni/ bum pa 'bul ba sngon du song nas/ rdul tshon gyi mthar dri bzang pos sbags pa'i til dkar po'i mar khus kho ra khor yug tu phye ma med par byugs la/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa dang gtor ma dang 'og tu dgos pa'i bum pa la sogs pa rnams kyang tshang bar bshams/ de nas dpon slob rnams stan la 'khod de mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya/ bum pa bzla ba ni sta gon gyi skabs su bsgrubs zin pas nub dang po la mi dgos la/ sgrub mchod sbrel mar byed na 'di'i skabs su bya zhing*/

de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i phyir/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas brtsams te/ bdag gtso bo dang tha mi dad kyi bar byas/ gnas gsum byin gyi rlabs pa dang gshegs su gsol ba'i ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor bsam/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod pa lngas mchod/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas mnyes par byas nas rang la thim pas/ lha dgu so so'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang pa re bsam/ de dag gi thugs kar yang pad zla'i steng du rang rang gi gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib byang bar bsam zhing*/ gtso bo la

kāṃ ka ni dang*/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi sngags ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag sogs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ myur du 'khor ba dang ngan song nas 'don pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig / ces brjod la dku g.yon du se gol gtogs/ /bdag nyid gtso bo las phye nas shar sgor 'khod de mchod bstod dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ bdag 'jug rnams nyung ngu rnam gsal nyid nas 'byung ba ltar rdzogs par byas la grub na dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag len du tshul bzhin bya ste dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma 'jug pa'i bya ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba nas brtsams te rtogs bskyed kyi bar bdag 'jug bzhin byas la/ mtha' rten gyi skabs su/ thog mar tshigs bcad dang sngags rnams spel nas khrus byed du gzhug cing*/ slar yang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin du sdig sgrib kyi tshab tu/ nad gdon/ nye bar 'tshe ba/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba/ 'khon dang grib dang mi gtsang ba/ byad dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa/ mtshan mo nag mo/ /bdud kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i gnod pa thams cad/ rgyal po dang the rang gi gnod pa/ klu dang sa bdag gis gnod pa/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa zhes tshan pa re re nas bzhug cing mthar/ mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing khrus byas la/

de nas byab pa ni/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi dkyil du zla ba la hūṃ gi mtha' mar gzungs sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ des slob ma rnams kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad byabs par bsam zhing*/ sngar gyi shīn+taṃ ku ru 'i tshab tu a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rma bya'i sgros byab bo/ /de nas bsrung ba ni/ lus kyi gnas bdun la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ rdo rje rgya gram re bzhag pas/ rdo rje de las rdo rje de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros nas slob ma'i lus go mtshams med pa'i rdo rjes bsdams par bsam zhing*/ a pa na 'i tshab tu rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes brjod la/ slar yang slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags rnams kyi nus mthu yis/ /'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrung zin gyis/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig / ces re re nas brjod pa'i mthar/ bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ slob ma rnams kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms shing*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyu ra par bsams la/ rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin du slob ma'i lag tu gtad de/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi/ ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des ni sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis rlabs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir yang tshe dang ldan pa 'di rnams me long gi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig / de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang 'dra bar byas la/ gi haṃ thogs la/ gi haṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/

/nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi byed shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po ches srungs kyis gi haṃ phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/ zho thogs te/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes legs rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyis dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la zhing ba'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/ dur ba thogs la/ dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel bar shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la rtswa 'tshong khye'u bkra shis kyis rtswa dur ba phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/ bil ba thogs la/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun grub gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha tshangs pas shing thog bil ba phyag tu phul ba na / sogs kyis sbyin/ dung thogs la/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// chos rnams ma 'dres yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/ li khri thogs la/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang*/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyod srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/ yungs kar thogs la/

yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi bar shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyi rlabs pa de bzhin du/ /deng 'dir yang tshe dang ldan pa 'di rnams yungs kar gyi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /de dag gis gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pa'i 'dun pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis/ khyod kyi slob mar gzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ lan gsum brjod de/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rjes chog ltar bkra shis kyi bar du legs par bsgrub cing*/ sgrub mchod zhag mang po byed na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes sogs brjod/ nub tha ma la mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes su dngos grub blang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rdul tshon gyi lha rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gnang*/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol la/ chos thams cad bdag med pa'i don dran par byas la/ rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshig cing*/ lha'i gdan la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams kyang bsdus la rol mo dang bcas pas rdul tshon mtha' nas dbus su phyogs la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ/ ad+ya nud pan+na twa da oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

zhes brjod la bum pa'am za ma tog sogs su rdul tshon bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ thig rjes rnams dri bzang gi chus byugs la mi mngon par bya zhing*/ me tog sil ma gtor te bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /ngan song rgyun gcod nyung gsal cho ga'i tshul/ /brgyud ldan gsung gi bcud bsdus 'thor ba bsdebs/ /de yi zur 'debs gsal byed nyer 'kho 'di/ /'gro la phan pa'i bsam pas 'dir bkod do/ /'dir 'bad las byung rab dkar dge ba'i rgyun/ /dung dang kha ba'i dum bu brtsegs 'dra ba/ /bdag gi rgyud la nges par thob pa des/ /'gro ba'i las sgrib mun pa sel gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ brgyud pa gong ma'i gsungs thor bur gnas pa rnams gzhan la phan pa'i blos phyogs gcig tu sdebs te/ btsun pa grol mchog gis nye bar bkod pa'o// // 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig/ shubhaṃ mastu sarba dzā ga taṃ// zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs rnam gsal bzhugs/ -PAGE 292--PAGE 291--PAGE 290-
